## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-change-of-ownership-term

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. B: loan maturities, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** A 7(a) acquisition loan amortizes over no more than 10 years (special purpose property aside) and cannot have a balloon.
- **Quote:** "7(a) loans are required to have a stated amortization, loan maturity, and may not have a balloon. 7(a) loans that facilitate a change of ownership must not have an amortization that exceeds 10 years, except as provided below for transactions involving Special Purpose Properties."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-dsc-definition

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. C.2: definition of historical DSC, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** Historical debt service coverage is EBITDA divided by all debt service after the transaction, not only the SBA loan payment.
- **Quote:** "The historical DSC ratio is defined as earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) divided by the combined debt service post-transaction."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-dsc-ratio

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15 (7(a) Changes of Ownership), Para. C.2: debt service coverage, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** For a 7(a) change of ownership, the lender tests debt service coverage on the last fiscal year-end or the average of the last two, at 1.25:1 for an initial acquisition or owner buyout and 1.15:1 for a business expansion.
- **Quote:** "The Debt Service Coverage (DSC) ratio must be satisfied using either the last fiscal year-end or an average of the last two fiscal year-end statements on either a historical or adjusted basis based on the transaction type: Initial Acquisition: 1.25:1 Business Expansion: 1.15:1 Owner Buyout: 1.25:1 ESOP and Cooperative: 1.25:1"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-owner-compensation

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. C.2.b: owner compensation, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** The buyer’s pay from the business must cover their personal obligations and living expenses.
- **Quote:** "The ownership compensation of the Applicant must be sufficient to support their current obligations and living expenses."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26
